description: This source file defines a static class 'SendCode' that adds an endpoint for sending email-based two-factor authentication codes in an OrchardCore module. It includes methods for handling the request, generating email content, and sending the email.

classes.name: SendCode
classes.description: A static class providing endpoint setup and handling for sending email verification codes in two-factor authentication.

methods.name: AddEmailSendCodeEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a POST endpoint for sending email verification codes, mapped to 'TwoFactor-Authenticator/EmailSendCode'.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the process of generating and sending a two-factor email code to the user.

methods.name: GetSubjectAsync
methods.description: Generates the email subject content based on settings and templates.

methods.name: GetBodyAsync
methods.description: Generates the email body content based on settings and templates.

methods.name: GetContentAsync
methods.description: Renders the email content using Liquid templates, injecting user and code data.
